name: omahop
author: Felipe Paiva
description: Fast window switching for Omarchy floating workspaces: Alt+Tab shows a list of your windows in the Omarchy theme, with a settings window. Adds nothing to the bar. Needs one line in hyprland.lua, see the README. Open the settings from the launcher or with: omarchy-shell shell toggle io.github.felipecpaiva.omahop
